name: BastionGPT
description: BastionGPT is a HIPAA-compliant AI assistant and medical scribe offering access to GPT-5.5, Claude Sonnet, and Gemini-3 Pro within a healthcare-grade interface. Professional tier at $20/user/month includes core AI assistant, unlimited transcription, and BAA. Professional Plus at $45/user/month adds extended document capacity and multi-document reference. Ultra tier custom pricing for 100+ users with SSO and dedicated support. Zero PHI breaches across 10,000+ healthcare organizations over 3 years. 99.3% sentence-level accuracy in peer-reviewed Baylor/Texas Children's study. 7-day free trial with 45-day money-back guarantee. Supports HIPAA, 42 CFR Part 2, FERPA, PIPEDA, PHIPA, Australian APP.

faqs.q: BastionGPT vs Doximity Ask: which is better?
faqs.a: Doximity Ask is free for US physicians with verified credentials. BastionGPT ($20-75/mo) offers multi-model access (GPT/Claude/Gemini), transcription, and works for all healthcare roles. For free clinical AI, Doximity. For broader capabilities and non-physician roles, BastionGPT.
